items.source: Properties in form key=value that should be added to the Spring Environment before the test runs.
items.translation: 要在测试运行之前添加到 Spring Environment 的 form key=value 格式的属性。

items.source: Auto-configuration exclusions that should be applied for this test.
items.translation: 应应用于此测试的自动配置排除项。

items.source:
A set of exclude filters which can be used to filter beans that would otherwise be
added to the application context.
items.translation: 一组排除过滤器，可用于过滤本应添加到应用上下文的 Bean。

items.source:
A set of include filters which can be used to add otherwise filtered beans to the
application context.
items.translation: 一组包含过滤器，可用于将其他过滤器排除的 bean 添加到应用程序上下文中。

items.source: Using this annotation only enables auto-configuration that is relevant to Data Neo4j tests. Similarly, component scanning is limited to Neo4j repositories and entities (@Node and @RelationshipProperties).
items.translation: 仅使用此注解可启用与 Data Neo4j 测试相关的自动配置。同样，组件扫描仅限于 Neo4j 仓库和实体（`@Node` 和 `@RelationshipProperties`）。

items.source: By default, tests annotated with @DataNeo4jTest are transactional with the usual test-related semantics (i.e. rollback by default). This feature is not supported with reactive access so this should be disabled by annotating the test class with @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED).
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用 @DataNeo4jTest 注解的测试是事务性的，具有通常的测试相关语义（即默认回滚）。此功能不支持反应式访问，因此应通过用 @Transactional(propagation = Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED) 注解测试类来禁用该功能。

items.source: Eddú Meléndez, Stephane Nicoll, Artsiom Yudovin
items.translation: Eddú Meléndez, Stephane Nicoll, Artsiom Yudovin

items.source: When using JUnit 4, this annotation should be used in combination with @RunWith(SpringRunner.class).
items.translation: 在使用 JUnit 4 时，此注解应与 @RunWith(SpringRunner.class)` 结合使用。

items.source: Determines if default filtering should be used with @SpringBootApplication.
items.translation: 确定是否应使用默认过滤功能与 @SpringBootApplication。

items.source: Determines if default filtering should be used with @SpringBootApplication. By default no beans are included.
items.translation: 确定是否应使用默认过滤功能配合 @SpringBootApplication。默认情况下不包含任何 Bean。

items.source: if default filters should be used
items.translation: 如果应使用默认过滤器
